title: The Journey of Victor
subtitle: From initial ideation in 2009 to a pan-India corporate fleet and international expansion across the United Arab Emirates.

milestones.title: Official Registration
milestones.description: Victor was registered as a private limited company under the Indian Companies Act, 1956.

milestones.title: First Major Client
milestones.description: Victor secured a major corporate client after two years in the industry.

milestones.title: Fleet Expansion
milestones.description: The fleet grew to more than 800 vehicles.

milestones.title: Continued Growth
milestones.description: The fleet expanded to more than 1,500 vehicles.

milestones.title: Navigating COVID-19
milestones.description: Victor focused on educating drivers and partners about WHO-recommended safety norms.

milestones.title: Business Recovery
milestones.description: Victor successfully navigated the pandemic and resumed operations at full capacity.

milestones.title: Pan-India Expansion
milestones.description: Victor decided to expand operations into metropolitan cities across India.

milestones.title: International Expansion
milestones.description: Victor expanded into international markets, beginning with the United Arab Emirates.

milestones.title: Sustainability Commitment
milestones.description: Victor committed to working toward a fleet comprising 15–30% electric vehicles.

milestones.title: Pan-India Operations
milestones.description: Victor commenced full-fledged operations across India.

milestones.title: UAE Operations
milestones.description: Victor commenced full-fledged operations in the United Arab Emirates.

milestones.title: Advancing Sustainable Mobility
milestones.description: Strengthened market presence, expanded fleet, enhanced digital solutions and accelerated EV adoption for a cleaner tomorrow.
